measures.id: City of Lansing Essential Services Millage Restoration Proposal
measures.title: Essential Services Millage Restoration
measures.summary: Would restore Lansing's charter property tax from the rolled-back 19.2214 mills to the full 20 mills, an increase of 0.7786 mill ($0.7786 per $1,000 of taxable value), for 2027 through 2031. The money funds essential services including police and fire protection and local road and sidewalk maintenance. It is estimated to raise about $2,585,101 in the first year.
measures.yesMeans: Lansing's charter millage is restored to 20 mills for 2027 through 2031.
measures.noMeans: The charter millage stays at the rolled-back 19.2214 mills.

measures.id: Citizens' Advisory Healthcare Action Board Charter Amendment
measures.title: Citizens' Advisory Healthcare Action Board Charter Amendment
measures.summary: Would amend the Lansing City Charter to require creating a Citizens' Advisory Healthcare Action Board. The board would write a Lansing Healthcare Action Plan and make recommendations to the community on healthcare costs and access. The amendment sets the board's powers, duties, membership and organization, and requires the plan to be published, presented publicly and accompanied by implementation recommendations.
measures.yesMeans: The charter would require a Citizens' Advisory Healthcare Action Board and a Lansing Healthcare Action Plan.
